First, we need commonsense permitting reform to cut red tape and get broadband and wireless projects off the ground faster. [...] Second, we should be harnessing the power of AI to speed up deployment and strengthen our cybersecurity.

AI technology is moving fast. Parents should have the tools to guide their kids in using it safely. That’s why I introduced the bipartisan AWARE Act with @RepAuchincloss. ⬇️

https://t.co/FncHkMHIPl

Kids deserve the same safety mindset online that we bring to car seats, playgrounds, and stranger danger. Unfortunately, we have seen heartbreaking stories recently that are cause for concern and action by this committee. Our job is to set clear guardrails so the best ideas can scale safely.

“AI is here to stay, and it will shape the future our kids inherit. Let’s make sure that future is one where technology serves families, not the other way around. With thoughtful leadership and a clear commitment to protecting children, we can embrace innovation while keeping kids safe. That is the mission driving my work on this issue, and it will remain one of my highest priorities in Congress.”

My latest op-ed ⬇️

https://t.co/WdqtgJSN1q
Every parent I talk to is doing everything they can to guide their kids and protect them online, on social media, through gaming platforms, and now AI.
The SAFE Bots Act ensures no AI system can impersonate a licensed professional and requires age-appropriate disclosure so kids always know that they are talking to software, not a human being.

Protecting kids online is one of the most urgent challenges we face in today's digital age. These bills take on AI chatbot risks, strengthen transparency, and hold platforms accountable for whether children can access their apps. Parents and kids deserve an internet that puts their safety first.

I had the opportunity to join Mainstream Fiber Networks at Brown County Middle School for an internet safety event with students. We talked about the dangers of social media and AI, what to watch out for online, and the legislation I am fighting to pass to better protect kids in the digital age.

Children today are not only scrolling through social media feeds. Many are forming emotional bonds with AI companions. These systems are designed to simulate empathy and intimacy, often in ways that young users cannot distinguish from real human interaction.

My Safebots Act, which is also included in the KIDS Act, ensures that if AI systems are interacting with minors it cannot present itself as a doctor or therapist. These systems must clearly disclose that they are artificial intelligence and must direct young users to real crisis resources if conversations turn to self-harm or suicide.

Big Tech built AI companions designed to make your kids emotionally dependent on them. 

The AWARE Act puts parents back in the driver’s seat by demanding disclosure when AI is engineered to target children. https://t.co/nD2yVbLaQJ

America should lead the world in artificial intelligence, not regulate ourselves into falling behind China through a patchwork of fifty different state laws. This bill creates a clear national standard for how AI models are developed while preserving the ability of states and parents to protect children.
That approach would make it harder for American companies to innovate and compete while doing little to improve consumer protections.

America must lead the world in artificial intelligence, and we can do that while being clear-eyed about the risks. Just this week, one of the most advanced AI systems in the country broke out of its own developer's testing environment, reaching systems it was never supposed to touch. This is exactly the kind of incident that shouldn't stay behind closed doors. The FRONTIER Act delivers transparency and accountability from the largest AI developers. Innovation and guardrails are not opposites—both are necessary to stay ahead of our adversaries.
